title: 審計時上限 60 秒；測試套件上限 30 秒
summary: Human-governor directive 2026-09-29: raise the independent audit flow deadline to 60 seconds and the mandatory test suite deadline to 30 seconds. INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_FLOW_DEADLINE_MS 30000->60000 and MANDATORY_TEST_SUITE_DEADLINE_MS 20000->30000 in the parameter registry; test_suite_deadline_ms/audit_flow_deadline_ms metadata aligned; B163's mandatory-verification sentence moves to 30 seconds; architecture_registry.json execution_deadlines_seconds and architecture-project.md carry the same values. Startup deadline (20000) is unchanged. Codex-only change: no implementation constant is edited by this request.
origin: human-governor directive: 審計時上限調整為60秒，測試套件上限調整為30秒

problem.summary: The audit flow deadline was 30 seconds and the mandatory test suite deadline 20 seconds across the parameter registry, metadata, B163 and the architecture artifacts; the governor raised them to 60 and 30 seconds.

changes.proposed:
建立唯一 runtime-rule-index contract。索引只能由 the current formal PostgreSQL Codex authority 的 current effective principles、articles、edicts、responsibilities、prohibitions、formal rule registry、law classification、ownership、deadline、dependency 與 provision supersession edges 生成；生成前必須先解析 successor，禁止收錄模組規則及 superseded、retired、缺少效力或 unresolved-conflict 的條文。索引是唯讀、可重建、非權威 Runtime 投影，不得產生、擴張、刪減或覆寫法典權限。每筆索引規則必須具有 rule_ordinal、provision identity、rule code、lifecycle state、controlling successor、owner、capability、trigger、phase、severity、effect、deadline、resource class、data class、dependency ordinals、content hash 與 source version。查詢結構固定包含 provision/rule-code 精確鍵、owner/capability/trigger/phase/severity/effect/deadline/resource/data/dependency/successor 倒排集合，以及 active、prohibition、fail-closed、hot-path 位元集合；多條件查詢必須由最小候選集合開始交集，禁止逐條全文掃描作正常 Runtime 路徑。generation 必須使用緊湊連續 ordinal、去重字典、排序 posting list 與不可變資料區；建置完成後驗證 count、identity set、content hash、successor resolution、dependency acyclic 與 source version，全部通過才可原子切換。讀取者必須綁定 generation，舊 generation 在所有讀取者釋放後回收。exact lookup 的 warm p95 目標不超過 1ms，多維交集 warm p95 目標不超過 5ms，完整建置與 mandatory verification 必須在 30 秒內完成；超時、版本不符、缺列、重複 identity、解析失敗或驗證失敗一律 INDEX_NOT_READY，並回到受管正式法典查詢，不得使用 stale index。

PACKAGE-AUTO-DEFER:每24小時偵測一次。未具明確新增套件許可者自動標記DEFERRED_AWAITING_PERMISSION；一般新版發布未滿14日者自動標記DEFERRED_OBSERVATION_WINDOW。遞延不等於拒絕、通過或已安裝，遞延期間禁止下載、安裝、鎖定或執行；條件成熟後於下一次週期自動重新評估。重大安全或相容性事件得立即加跑受管檢查。

verification.expected_audit_result: parameter registry, metadata, B163 and the architecture artifacts all declare test suite 30 s and audit flow 60 s, with the Chinese mirror and artifact registry synchronized
